readmeHtml:
GhostTrack

Useful tool to track location or mobile number, so this tool can be called osint or also information gathering

New update : Version 2.2

Instalation on Linux (deb)

sudo apt-get install git
sudo apt-get install python3

Instalation on Termux

pkg install git
pkg install python3

Usage Tool

git clone https://github.com/HunxByts/GhostTrack.git
cd GhostTrack
pip3 install -r requirements.txt
python3 GhostTR.py

Display on the menu IP Tracker

on the IP Track menu, you can combo with the seeker tool to get the target IP

⚡ Install Seeker : - Get Seeker

Display on the menu Phone Tracker

on this menu you can search for information from the target phone number

Display on the menu Username Tracker

on this menu you can search for information from the target username on social media
⚡ Author : - HunxByts

aiSummary.oneLiner: A lightweight, stealthy OSINT tool for tracking digital footprints across public databases and social platforms.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: GhostTrack is an open-source intelligence (OSINT) framework designed to help security researchers and investigators track digital identities. It aggregates data from various public APIs, social media platforms, and breached databases to build a comprehensive profile of a target username or email address. The tool is heavily focused on stealth and rate-limit evasion, utilizing rotating proxies and asynchronous requests to gather information without triggering security alerts. It outputs its findings in a clean, linkable graph format, making it easier to visualize connections between different online personas.
keyFeatures: Multi-platform reconnaissance: Scans hundreds of social media sites and forums simultaneously to check for username availability and usage.
Proxy rotation and evasion: Implements advanced rate-limiting bypasses and proxy rotation to remain undetected during large scans.
Breach data integration: Cross-references targets against known public data breaches to identify compromised accounts or linked emails.
Graph-based visualization: Outputs findings into a visual format, mapping the connections between discovered aliases and accounts.
Asynchronous architecture: Built for speed, allowing rapid querying of numerous endpoints concurrently.

useCases.title: Threat intelligence gathering

useCases.title: Digital footprint auditing

useCases.title: Investigative journalism
useCases.description: Journalists use the visualization features to map connections between different online identities associated with a story.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: Security researchers, penetration testers, and OSINT investigators. Requires knowledge of Python and understanding of network security principles.
aiSummary.gettingStarted: Install the requirements, configure your proxy list in the settings, and run the main script with a target username.
